13931.6 in, §92, N column of the table of relative positions (centre of the First to centre of the Second Pyramid); 353.86 m at 0.0254 m/inch. Petrie heads the columns N and E, but the Second Pyramid lies south and west of the First, so this is stored as a southward offset. His parallels are inclined −5′ to true north, the mean azimuth of the First and Second Pyramids, whereas this repo's frame is east-north-up on true north; at this distance 5′ is a cross-track shift of 0.51 m. Petrie's figure is kept unrotated, and he states no error for these distances, so sigma is that shift rounded up.
